title: Stelar's Cobblemon 3
description: A Cobblemon-focused adventure modpack I made for me and my friends. Centered around Cobblemon, it features popular worldgen, storage, and agriculture mods to enhance the Mon experience!
body:
Stelar's Cobblemon 3 is an adventure modpack centered around the mod Cobblemon. It is the latest in a series of modpacks I have released on other platforms. My modpack features mods that add worldgen, vehicles, additional agriculture, tech, and expanded storage, all with the goal of enhancing the Cobblemon experience! This modpack is around 200 mods with most being optimization mods and the overall pack falls into the medium-load category.

I made this modpack for my friends, and with the release of Cobblemon 1.7 we wanted to freshen up the experience. We prefer survival packs that aren't mob-centric, and thus we play on Easy mode with the Apathy mod to make monsters non-hostile. This means the world is free to explore and catch mons in, night and day! If you're a fan of playing Pokemon and enjoy chill, relaxing Minecraft, this is the pack for you!

There is a starter kit for each Pokedex color when you first spawn, simply select which kit you want and you'll get some items to help you start your Cobblemon journey! I have included my own keybinds that consider lots of the major mods. You're free to keep them as they are, or adjust them to your liking! Also, remember to adjust your memory allotment to account for the size of the modpack (you'll want at least 8gb). By default, I have the Complimentary Unbound shader turned on.

I do not own any of these mods, all rights belong to their respective developers.
